title: Author-in-the-loop Agentic Reproducibility Auditing for a Machine Learning Conference
abstract: arXiv:2610.22465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reproducibility checks during peer review require a shared understanding of what authors' code is expected to reproduce. We present an author-in-the-loop collaborative audit that makes author declarations explicit inputs to an AI agent's investigation and assessment. A structured checklist records reproduction instructions and limitations; a two-stage workflow on GitHub connects agent checks to author clarification, revision, and agent reassessment. The agent separately assesses whether results have been reproduced and whether authors need to provide clarification or make repairs, while human reviewers approve requests and decide whether concerns are resolved. We deployed the system across 36 conference papers and 133 experimental tables and figures, raising 20 issues after human review. tldr: 该论文提出了一种作者在环的智能体可复现性审计方法，通过结构化清单和GitHub两阶段工作流将AI智能体检查与作者澄清、修改及重新评估相结合，并在36篇会议论文上部署验证了其有效性。
